def largest_prime_factor(n: int) -> int:
    """Return the largest prime factor of n. Assume n > 1 and is not a prime."""
    
    # Handle factors of 2 separately to allow skipping even numbers later
    while n % 2 == 0:
        last = 2
        n //= 2
    
    # Check odd divisors from 3 up to sqrt(n)
    i = 3
    while i * i <= n:
        if n % i == 0:
            last = i
            n //= i
            # Continue dividing by the same factor until it no longer divides
            while n % i == 0:
                n //= i
        else:
            i += 2
    
    # If n > 1 after the loop, then the remaining n is a prime larger than any found so far
    if n > 1:
        last = n
    
    return last
